statement.zh: 《新干商代大墓》（1997）正式报告江西新干大洋洲商代高等级墓葬出土青铜器、玉器与陶瓷。
statement.en: The 1997 Xingan Shang tomb report publishes bronzes, jades, and ceramics from Dayangzhou, Jiangxi.
